market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a high-profile L2 project backed by Pudgy Penguins, and comparable L2 tokens have launched with FDVs well over $1B. A $200M threshold is extremely low, so the chance of exceeding it is high. I estimate an 82% probability of >$200M, versus the market’s 76.5%, giving a small edge to Yes.
evidence_points: Major L2 tokens (Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync, Starknet) all launched with FDVs multiple billions, making $200M a modest target.
Abstract’s link to the Pudgy Penguins ecosystem provides a strong, ready-made community likely to drive demand.
Igloo Inc. has raised venture funding and publicly committed to a token launch, making a complete failure to launch by 2027 unlikely.
sources_consulted: Recent L2 token launch FDVs (general market knowledge)
Pudgy Penguins brand strength and community size
